reviewer_role: Independent-role protocol/evaluator agent; not external organizational review

findings.issue: Uncaught outer subprocess TimeoutExpired aborts the campaign and omits a failed receipt and later attempts.
findings.correction: Catch TimeoutExpired and launch/read failures; persist a failed receipt with task identity/context/complexity, observed outer time, null unmeasured CPU, timeout reason and captured output; continue scheduled jobs. Do not rerun/replace the failed attempt.

findings.issue: Scale sum uses total_cpu_seconds or 0; analysis assumes numeric CPU for every job. Timeout/missing receipts therefore zero-fill missing cost quantities or crash analysis.
findings.correction: Report known CPU subtotal, missing count, and null total when any job CPU is unmeasured. Summary statistics should handle missing values explicitly and retain all attempt/acceptance denominators.

findings.issue: The stated 30-second job/worker limit is ambiguous as the common employer deadline while modeled human effort spans 5–60 minutes. Applying it to humans would handicap the comparison.
findings.correction: Distinguish a shared employer turnaround requirement from the system process safety cap. Do not price a human scenario as comparable if it violates the shared employer deadline.

findings.issue: CPU timer begins after Python imports/startup and receipt serialization occurs after the sampled total; process-turnaround includes these but measured CPU does not.
findings.correction: Label CPU as instrumented worker-and-child CPU excluding uninstrumented interpreter startup/receipt tail, or measure process CPU externally. This is not material to complete-cost claims because fully allocated cost remains unknown.

findings.issue: No-settlement check treats an absent authority field as empty, and lacks explicit settlement value assertion.
findings.correction: Require pack authority to be explicitly [] and settlement explicitly NOT_CONNECTED; retain this check separately from business deliverable correctness.

positive_findings: 36-job statistical unit is kept separate from the natural showcase, successor aggregate and108 timing repeats.
Human market comparison is explicitly modeled; adjacent historical time is not mislabeled as a matched observation.
No active-model provider cost is claimed for deterministic local execution; development and full economic costs remain unknown.
Generator, seeds, complexity sizes, ordering, oracle and analysis are prospective and no confirmation callback or retuning path was found.
The first portable tool is actually invoked on fresh task paths, while scope remains known exact reconciliation plus composition.
Acceptance oracle uses independent Python CSV/SQLite reference and the prior five corruption probes rejected.
The reported natural showcase is development-selected and is not included in the held-out36 denominator.
